About

A builder with an engineer's patience

A motivated Physical Science student with a strong passion for robotics, mechatronics, automation and artificial intelligence. Alongside academic studies, I bring practical experience in event management, leadership, technology projects and first-aid support.

I communicate clearly, work well in a team and enjoy solving problems. I like turning creative ideas into meaningful projects and exploring possibilities beyond conventional boundaries.

I aspire to pursue higher education in Robotics and Mechatronics Engineering, specialising in automation and artificial intelligence, with the goal of developing innovative technologies that benefit people and society.

Project story · Grade 8

Multifunctional Remote-Controlled Robot

Robotics, electronics, wireless communication and environmental monitoring combined in a single system.

  • Environmental monitoringMeasures humidity levels and detects gas levels using sensors.
  • BluetoothWireless communication for monitoring and control.
  • Wi-Fi cameraEnables remote visual monitoring.
  • Long-range controlA dedicated radio transmitter, with a target range of up to 1 km under suitable conditions.
  • HardwareA microcontroller, sensors, motor-control electronics and a mobile robotic platform.
  • What I learnedEmbedded systems, sensor integration, wireless communication, robotics and practical problem-solving.
Looking back at something I built in Grade 8 reminds me how early experimentation can spark a lasting interest in engineering and technology.

#Robotics #Electronics #EmbeddedSystems #Engineering #STEM #WirelessCommunication #StudentProjects #Innovation
